policy.human_only: Advisor feedback records a human judgement; automated judgement is not allowed in this phase.
policy.no_pseudo_scoring: Accuracy is one of four qualitative labels, never a number and never a weighted score.
policy.evidence_bound: confirmed_evidence and refuted_evidence must reference evidence_id values from the advisor report.
policy.separation: Feedback never mutates the advisor report, the Story Lock, episode state or story gates.
